approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Decommissions and purchase surpluses that require approval by the Head of IT.
approvals.only_approver_hint: Only the Head of IT can approve or reject. You can check the status of your requests and cancel them while they are pending.
approvals.empty_pending: There are no requests pending approval.
approvals.own_request: Your own request: someone else approves it.

approve_effect.BAJA: On approval, the device leaves the inventory, its licenses are released and the decommission is recorded in the kardex with your name as approver.
approve_effect.RECEPCION_SOBRANTE: On approval, the full delivery (including the surplus) is recorded exactly as it was received.
approve_effect.AJUSTE_CONSUMIBLE: On approval, the stock drops to the counted amount and the adjustment is recorded in the ledger. If the stock changed since the request, it is not applied.
approve_effect.CIERRE_FALTANTE: On approval, the order is closed and the pending items will no longer be received.
approve_effect.CANCELACION_ORDEN: On approval, the order is cancelled.
approve_effect.RECLASIFICACION: On approval, the assets are retired as “Reclassified” and the consumable receives the same quantity.

import.title: Import assets
import.subtitle: Load assets from Excel and review every row before saving.
import.formats: Excel (.xlsx), up to 1000 rows and 5 MB.
import.columns_help: The template headers and those of the INVENTARIO sheet are recognized: Code, Category, Description, Brand, Model, Serial number, Hostname, Location, Purchase date, Invoice, Cost, Currency and Notes. Assets are created as available; assignments are made afterwards with the workstation handover.

how.1: Download the template: it includes the existing categories, locations and brands.
how.2: Fill in one row per asset. Without a code, one is generated with the category prefix; without a serial number, the code is used.
how.3: Upload the file and review the result row by row. Nothing is saved yet.
how.4: Confirm: everything is created in a single operation, recorded in the kardex.

msg.TYPE_FROM_CODE: Category inferred from the code prefix

catalog_center.drag_hint: Drag the rows to change the order in which they appear in forms.
catalog_center.merge_help: Everything that uses this entry will move to the target entry. This one will become inactive and keep a reference to the target; the operation is recorded in the audit log.
catalog_center.merge_nothing: No records use it: it will only become inactive.
catalog_center.specs_help: Choose an asset type and indicate which specifications must be recorded. Missing required ones appear in the data quality review.
catalog_center.specs_empty: This type does not require any specifications yet.
catalog_center.kits_help: Equipment a role or department receives when someone joins. The job handover proposes them first.
catalog_center.kits_empty: There are no role kits yet.
catalog_center.kit_delete_confirm: Do you want to delete the kit “{{name}}”?

motivos-movimiento.RETIRO_USO: No longer used in the area

batch_edit.help: Tick only what you want to change; everything else stays the same. If one asset does not accept the change, it is applied to none.
batch_edit.location_help: Only equipment without custody: the location of assigned equipment follows its custody.
batch_edit.value_help: Leave it empty to remove it.

person_file.no_licenses: No licenses or accounts are assigned.

assets.title: Assets
assets.step1: Type the code, serial number or hostname, or filter by type and status. Filters stay in the address and can be saved as a view.
assets.step2: Click a row to see the full record: details, software, components, history and attachments.
assets.step3: Each row offers only what can be done for its status: assign, return, transfer, open a ticket or print the label.
assets.step4: Select several assets to hand them over, return them, edit cost, warranty or location, or dispose of them at once.

movements.title: Movements
movements.step1: Choose the equipment, the person and the area; the system suggests the usual area and the reason.
movements.step2: Reasons come from the catalog center; “Other” asks for a written detail.
movements.step3: When finished, download the handover record for the person to sign.
movements.step4: Every movement is recorded in the equipment ledger and in the person's record.

software.title: Software and licenses
software.step1: Enter the name, version and manufacturer (from the brand list).
software.step2: Choose the commercial model, the activation method and how seats are counted; the form asks for exactly what that activation needs.
software.step3: Paste a list (one account per line) and review the preview before saving.
software.step4: “Show” displays the password for 30 seconds and is recorded; after a person leaves, change their account password.

catalogs.title: Catalog center
catalogs.step1: Catalogs are grouped by topic on the left.
catalogs.step2: Type a new entry at the top; names are edited directly in the table.
catalogs.step3: Drag rows to set the order in forms; deactivate instead of deleting.
catalogs.step4: “Merge” moves everything using a duplicate entry to the right one and leaves a record in the audit log.

persons.title: Employees
persons.step1: Filter by name, email or department.
persons.step2: You will see their equipment, licenses and accounts, consumables and history on a single page.
persons.step3: “Job handover” assigns several devices and licenses in a single operation.
persons.step4: The departure returns their equipment, releases their accounts and flags which passwords to change.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.step1: Choose the equipment, who requests it and the fault type; the equipment moves to “Under repair”.
maintenance.step2: Add each action from the catalog with its cost.
maintenance.step3: When closed, the equipment becomes available again and the cost stays in its history.
maintenance.step4: Tickets open for more than 15 days appear in “My pending items”.

asset_class.auto: If left empty it is inferred from the name (Laptop → Computing, Printer → Printing).
asset_class.supply_notice: A supply is not registered as an asset: it is tracked by quantity in Consumables. Existing assets of this type can be converted with “Reclassify”.
asset_class.components_help: For example, a laptop accepts RAM, disk and battery. Empty: any type of the “Component” class.
asset_class.components_none: There are no types of the “Component” class.

help.COMPUTO: Assigned to a person; carries software, licenses and internal components (RAM, disk, battery).
help.MOVIL: Assigned to a person; carries software; identified by IMEI and line number.
help.PERIFERICO: Assigned to a person; no software or components.
help.IMPRESION: Installed in an area (optional person in charge); uses compatible consumables such as toner or ink.
help.RED: Installed in an area; has IP, MAC, ports and firmware.
help.ENERGIA: Installed in an area; accepts batteries as components.
help.AUDIOVISUAL: Installed in an area (projector, screen); may use consumables.
help.COMPONENTE: Installed inside another device, or kept in storage as a spare.
help.HERRAMIENTA: IT team tool; lent or assigned to a person.
help.INSUMO: Not an asset: tracked by quantity in Consumables.
help.OTRO: Assigned to a person; no software or components.

reclassify.title: Reclassify “{{tipo}}”
reclassify.explain_one: {{count}} asset of this type will become stock of a consumable. It is retired as “Reclassified” and its history is kept.
reclassify.explain_other: {{count}} assets of this type will become stock of a consumable. They are retired as “Reclassified” and their history is kept.
reclassify.blocked: These assets must be released first:

reasons.ASIGNADO: Assigned to a person (record the return)

reclassify.consumable_help: If it already exists at the site it receives the stock; otherwise it is created.
reclassify.approval_note: The Head of IT carries it out upon approval (Approvals).
reclassify.requested: Sent to the Head of IT for approval.

shared.install_help: A shared device is not in anyone's custody: it stays in the area and, if you wish, with a person in charge who reports faults or receives the toner.
shared.remove_help: The device goes back to storage. If it is damaged, open a maintenance ticket afterwards.
shared.responsible_help: Optional. It does not count as a device in their custody.
shared.removed: {{code}} was removed from the area and is in storage.

movement_reason.note_help: Optional unless the reason requires it. It is kept in the history and in the handover record.

asset_supplies.title: Device consumables
asset_supplies.subtitle: Compatible toner, ink or cartridges and every recorded change.
asset_supplies.no_compatible: No consumable is marked as compatible with this model (Consumables → edit → Compatibility).
asset_supplies.no_history: No consumable has been recorded for this device yet.

missing.help: What did not turn up in a count: investigate it, mark it as found or request its write-off for loss or theft.
missing.empty_open: There are no unresolved missing items.
missing.empty: There are no missing items recorded.

missing.write_off_help: It goes to the Head of IT for approval. If the device was assigned, first record the return with the reason “Loss or theft”.

missing.found_area_help: Corrects the location of the device.

done.localizado: Missing item resolved: the device turned up.
done.baja: The write-off is awaiting approval by the Head of IT.
